display_long_description:
TIME-BASED EXTREME CLIMBING

Each level is a timed ascent.
To succeed, you must:

Move efficiently

Maintain balance under pressure

Avoid hesitation at extreme heights

As you progress, structures become taller, routes narrower, and obstacles more demanding, turning every level into a high-stakes endurance test.

🧗 FULL-BODY VR WORKOUT

This is not a passive experience.

You will actively engage:

Core and abs through plank walking and balance control*

Arms, shoulders, and grip strength during vertical climbs (but also the back muscles and legs for some movements)

Leg stability and coordination on pipes, beams, and ladders*

*if you use rl locomotion

The result is a serious VR fitness session, combining adrenaline, fear management, and real physical effort.

EXTREME HEIGHT GAMEPLAY

Climb massive skyscrapers using full VR hand interaction

Walk across thin pipes, beams, and ledges hundreds of meters above the city

Reach the summit, then base jump and deploy your parachute to finish the run

Every mistake costs time. Every hesitation increases pressure.

ALWAYS INCREASING DIFFICULTY

20 handcrafted levels

Each level is taller, faster, narrower, and more intense

Designed to continuously push your reaction speed, nerves, and stamina

There are no easy climbs—only harder ones.

135 cyberpunk & synthwave tracks

Designed to maintain tension and rhythm during climbs

Most tracks are originally composed by us!
